featured.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
featured.tldr: KronLSTM replaces the delta rule with a Kronecker Delta Rule that edits one scalar association, giving provably bounded memory and better long-context recall than Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-3 at 1.5B scale.

featured.title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
featured.tldr: NoteBank adds a training-free sparse memory to pretrained linear-attention models, lifting Gated DeltaNet's million-token retrieval accuracy from 1.7% to 70.3% at almost no extra compute.

featured.title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
featured.tldr: UNREAL turns a frozen decoder-only LLM into its own retriever by adding under 500K trainable parameters, beating dedicated retriever-reranker pipelines over a 21M-chunk corpus and improving long-context accuracy by filtering distractors.
